segments.thig1.10:1.3: Dhārehi antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhanan”ti.

lines: Tare oghaṃ maccudheyyaṃ suduttaranti maccu ettha dhīyatīti maccudheyyaṃ, anupacitakusalasambhārehi suṭṭhu duttaranti suduttaraṃ, saṃsāramahoghaṃ tare ariyamagganāvāya tareyyāsi.
Dhārehi antimaṃ dehanti tassa taraṇeneva antimadehadharā hohīti attho.
